ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. The course will be taught via Collaborate v.12 and Compass 2G. Students will need a a web cam, working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. Access to scanner capable of producing .pdf files required for exam. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees. For ProctorU technical specifications and additional information visit: http://www.ao.uiuc.edu/support/source/student_services/proctoru_tech.html.
